title: 3 Undervalued Stocks With ROE Over 21%
summary: Global bond yields are climbing as investors factor in higher inflation and tighter central bank policy, which has put pressure on many large, rate-sensitive stocks. This article highlights three under followed stocks from a rigorous fundamental screener that may appeal to patient investors hunting for mispriced quality.
